summary: National Grid plc furnished a Form 6-K incorporating its 2026/27 half-year results statement for the period ended 30 September 2026, announced to the London Stock Exchange on 5 November 2026. The filing is a routine earnings release (equivalent to a US half-year results press release) accompanied by XBRL financial data and equity-movement detail; it discloses no transaction terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation on a deal, or advisor mandate. No special-situation event is present. Watch for any subsequent carve-out or disposal commentary in the results narrative rather than deal mechanics.
